subject.title: [Feature]: Intelligent Model Fallback with Wildcard/Auto Selection

question: Which public provider-family fallback contract should OpenClaw support for text agent failover: wildcard/auto refs, grouped fallbackFamilies, catalog-derived fallbacks, or no new fallback surface?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the options create different public config contracts and provider-routing semantics that automation should not choose on its own.

options.title: Design one provider-family fallback contract
options.body: Adopt one canonical contract and land it across schema, normalization, runtime candidate construction, fallback availability checks, docs, and focused tests.

options.title: Narrow to catalog-derived fallbacks
options.body: Use the narrower fallbacksFromModels direction from the related PR and leave wildcard/auto and fallbackFamilies out of scope for now.

options.title: Keep explicit fallbacks only
options.body: Document explicit fallbacks and auth.order as the supported path, then close this feature request as not planned.

recommendation.title: Design one provider-family fallback contract
recommendation.body: Adopt one canonical contract and land it across schema, normalization, runtime candidate construction, fallback availability checks, docs, and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest feature-history signal is the central model fallback resolver work and related runtime fallback refactors.
